annotations.rationale: Reference transition 'increase -> hold when [slp <= 0.01]' has no equivalent prediction because q0 uses the boundary-excluding guard 'slp < 0.01'.
Reference 'hold -> increase when [slp > 0.01]' matches prediction 'neutral -> increase when [slp > 0.01]' because 'neutral' is the renamed hold state with the same valve-neutral role.
Reference 'hold -> decrease when [slp < -0.01]' matches prediction 'neutral -> decrease when [slp < -0.01]' because 'neutral' semantically corresponds to hold and the guard is unchanged.
Reference 'decrease -> hold when [slp >= -0.01]' matches prediction 'decrease -> neutral when [slp >= -0.01]' because 'neutral' semantically corresponds to hold and the guard is unchanged.
Prediction 'increase -> neutral when [slp < 0.01]' is not equivalent to reference t0 because it excludes the required boundary case 'slp <= 0.01'.
Prediction 'decrease -> increase when [slp > 0.05]' is a spurious shortcut with no corresponding reference transition.

summary.notes: The renamed state 'neutral' is treated as a semantic match for 'hold'. No cascade transition FP is triggered because the pred-only state 'warning' is not used by any predicted transition.
